name: Risk-based inspection and integrity management
principle: RBI ranks equipment by probability of failure (from degradation mechanisms) and consequence so inspection effort goes where risk is highest.

process_steps.name: Estimate probability of failure from degradation mechanisms

suppliers.name: GE Digital (Meridium)
suppliers.product: APM integrity and risk-based inspection software

advantages: Shifts maintenance from reactive to proactive and avoids unnecessary shutdowns
limitations: The Wikipedia page gives no quantitative results and names no vendors

sources.note: Wikipedia, Risk-based inspection, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

notes: Process provenance: Documents the RBI methodology as Risk = Probability x Consequence, with the team workflow of collecting, reviewing and validating data, identifying and analysing risk, and building an inspection plan sized to condition and tolerated risk, including the diminishing returns on inspection effort.
